148 of its 156 counts (147).

**FIXED.** Periodic fit data through three points give AutoCAD's periodic cubic of 3 control points to a period, read
periodic, where the library gave a quadratic: its polylines of 5, 9, 15, 17, 31 and 54 vertices at 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10.

**CHANGED.** A `DxfSpline` read as the cubic through its fit points, of fit points alone or of control points that are not
their fit, gives that cubic's `Degree`, `ControlPoints`, `Knots`, `Weights` (none), `IsRational`, `NumControlPoints` and
`GetControlPointAt`, as AutoCAD 2021 gives them: five fit points alone of 71 2 are of degree 3 and 7 control points, where
the library gave 2 and none. An edit of its control points, knots, weights or degree, `InsertKnot` or `PurgeFitData` writes
the cubic to the record first. `ModifyPositionAndTangent` keeps the points at the knots of a spline of fit data as its fit
points (70 1288, closed 1289), and so do the pieces of `GetSplitCurves`, as AutoCAD saved and gave them, where the library
took the fit data out.

**CHANGED.** The first geometry read of a spline of a drawing reads its record in one pass: 2 000 fit splines of 20 points
with their control points, parsed and each asked its middle point, take 108 to 129 ms where they took 249 to 250 ms on .NET
Framework 4.8, 86 to 94 ms where they took 142 on .NET 10.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.DeleteRows` and `DeleteColumns` first merge across the table the rows AutoCAD 2021 merges when it
loads a file, and write them merged, as AutoCAD writes them after its own (check D33b, 35 tables saved and read back, 27
deletes): the first row, whatever its kind and whether the title is shown, and any other row of the title's kind, where no
block of merged cells reaches out of it and every cell after the block of its first cell holds no value or an empty text.
The title Parts left unmerged over an empty cell comes out merged across the table, the empty row a row put in before the
title left too; one with X, a space or nought beside it, or a block, stays as it is. The library wrote the row unmerged,
which AutoCAD merged again on reading, the hidden cells placed at the table's corner. Deletes of a table of 400 rows within
noise where no row merges.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.SetFormat` keeps a format on a number alone, as AutoCAD 2021 writes it (check D33b s01 to s19): a
whole number, a text or a value of another kind is written with none, 7 given `%lu2%pr2` still read 7, where the library
showed 7.00; a value of none becomes the empty value of no kind (`93 5`, `90 512`), even for an empty format; a block cell
keeps no format and loses its flag of its kind of value (0x40000); and each value given a format loses the flag 2 of its
value (`93 6` made 4), a number's too.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.GetOverrides` reads a cell's flag of its kind of value (0x40000) as `DataType | DataFormat`, as
AutoCAD 2021 reads it from a file (check D33): Qty of flags 262 144 has both, where the library gave `DataType` alone.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.ClearTableStyleOverrides` of 2 gives each cell the table's own looks of its row's kind as its own,
as AutoCAD 2021 writes them (check D33b c03, c06): the table of its own data of 9, GH_TXT, red and top left writes each data
cell `170 1`, `7 GH_TXT`, `64 1`, `140 9.0`, so that the cell shows what it showed; the library gave the cells none. Of 0
and 2 each cell of no value is written `93 5`, `90 512` and each block cell loses its flag 0x40000 (c13, c14), and so
`SetFromStyle`; of 1 the cells are left as they are.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.Fill` with `CopyFormat` turns a value of another kind into the source's, as `SetDataType` turns it
and AutoCAD 2021's `Fill` did (check D33b f02, f23 to f26, f31, f32): Mark under the look of 1.5 becomes a number of none,
the text 12 the number 12 shown 12.0000, 7 the number 7.000000, 1.5 under the look of 10 the whole number 1. The library kept
each value. AutoCAD fills the header and the title as rows of data, as the library did (f01 to f20). Existing tests
changed to AutoCAD's reading of `GetOverrides`: `DxfTableCellsTests.ACellsOwnKindOfValue_IsKeptByRemoveAllOverrides_AndBySetOverridesWhereItIsNamed`
(three assertions) and `DxfTableStructureTests.ACellsOwnKindOfValue_IsInheritedWithItsFormat`.

**CHANGED.** A `DxfMLeader`'s block keeps its landings as AutoCAD 2021 keeps them when it is scaled, turned or moved (check
D31d, 56 multileaders AutoCAD made; 64 the library made or edited, read by AutoCAD as it made its own, extents and all).
`BlockScale` and `BlockRotation` set move the block so that a leader from the left meets it at the base point of the content
(10 of the context data), with leaders or none, and land each leader on a side anew: the box from (-10, -5) to (20, 15) at
(100, 50), scaled by 2, stands at (110, 45), its leader on the right from (158, 55) for (128, 55); turned by 30 degrees, at
(105.49, 48.17). The library left the block where it was. `BlockPosition` set moves the base point and every leader's
dogleg with the block, a dogleg from (82, 55) to (112, 65) for the box moved to (130, 60), as `TextLocation` moves them for
words. `BlockContent` given to a multileader of no block puts the base point where a leader from the left meets the block,
as AutoCAD keeps it, where the library left it at the block's place. A block's scale or turn set after it is placed and
before its leaders moves it too, as AutoCAD moved it: a caller that set them there and wanted the block where it was sets
them before `BlockContent`.

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.TransformBy` leaves the multileader's own scale (10) and turn (43) of the block as they are, and
writes the block's matrix (47) as its transform where it then stands, as AutoCAD 2021 does (check D31d): a block scaled by 2
reads a `BlockScale` of 1, where the library read 2, and turned a quarter reads a `BlockRotation` of nought. `BlockRotation`
reads the multileader's own turn (43) before the turn the block is drawn with (46), as AutoCAD reads it: ezdxf's
multileader BA, drawn turned 15 degrees with 43 of nought, reads nought, where the library read 15 degrees. The block is
still drawn and exploded as the context data has it.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader` of a block turned half round about the y axis by `TransformBy` (AutoCAD's mirror about a line)
draws the block mirrored, its normal turned over and its scales kept, as AutoCAD 2021 writes it (check D31d,
k-transform-mirror): the box at (100, 50) so mirrored about the y axis spans
(-120, 45) to (-90, 65). The library drew it turned half round, from (-120, 35) to (-90, 55), and a `BlockScale` set after it
undid the mirror.

**CHANGED.** Words given to a `DxfMLeader` in a drawing by `MText` give it their text style (343, and the words' 340), with
the bit of the overrides of the text style (11) where it was not the multileader's already, as AutoCAD 2021 takes it (check
D31d): words of TS2 make a multileader of Standard's words of TS2; words that name no text style, read as Standard, make a
multileader of a style of TS2 of Standard. The words read by `MText` carry their text style, so that words given back as
read change nothing. The library kept the multileader's.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader`'s leader moved off its landing is landed anew when the content is laid out again, as AutoCAD 2021
lands it (check D31d): of two leaders on the left of "ABC" at (160, 40), the second moved off to (40, 70), a dogleg length
given to either, the same or another, `DoglegLength`, `LandingGap`, `TextHeight` or `Scale`, lands it from (150, 38) again,
on a block too (`BlockScale` and the doglegs); words met by several leaders on their left move under `Scale` by the gap
alone, (162, 42) at a scale of 2, their leaders landed anew from (142, 38), where the library moved them by the doglegs as
well, to (170, 42). A block met by several leaders on a side stays under `Scale`, as D31c guessed and AutoCAD confirmed.

Existing tests changed (5): `DxfMLeaderTests` (3: ezdxf's BA reads a `BlockRotation` of nought, a multileader transformed
keeps its own block scale and turn, the matrix of a block moved is its transform), and the turned block of
`DxfMLeaderD31bTests` and `DxfMLeaderD31cTests` given its scale and turn before its block, as AutoCAD's cases were. 18 new
tests of 34 cases, 32 red at base (`DxfMLeaderD31dTests`).

**CHANGED.** A leader added to a `DxfMLeader` by `AddLeader` has no landing yet (290 of nought), as AutoCAD 2021 writes it
(check D31e, 60 multileaders AutoCAD made, read alike by AutoCAD from the library's files of 54 of them): it draws no dogleg,
a line added to it has no vertex, and the first vertex given a line of it, by `AddFirstVertex` or `AddLastVertex`, becomes
its landing, the content left where it is, where the library put the vertex before a landing at the base point. Words at
(100, 50) given a second leader whose line is given (-20, 80) and its last vertex then set to (40, 70) stand at (160, 40),
the first leader landed from (150, 38), as AutoCAD's own, where the library moved them to (42, 72); the multileaders of
several leaders made so are then edited as AutoCAD edits its own. `SetDogleg` lands a leader of no landing, or one whose
dogleg it turns, on the side of the content the dogleg runs from, on the left of words or either side of a block, as
AutoCAD lands it: against x on the right of the box at (100, 50), from (128, 55). A leader so landed with no line draws its
dogleg, as AutoCAD draws it. `AddLeaderLine(point)` passes over a leader of no landing.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader`'s second leader on the right of a block, its dogleg set against x, its line given (270, 80) and its
last vertex set to (200, 70), moves the box at (100, 50) to (172, 65), as AutoCAD 2021 moves it (check D31e, k-right2-base):
the leader is landed on the box's right by `SetDogleg`, so that the box moves by as much as that landing. The library moved it
by the move from the base point, to (210, 65).

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.BlockScale` and `BlockRotation` set to the value they have do what any other value does, as AutoCAD
2021 does (check D31e): the block's matrix written as its transform where it stands, the block moved to be met at the base
point, its leaders landed anew; a block scaled by 2 by `TransformBy` given its `BlockScale` of 1 is drawn at 1 again, at
(190, 105). The library set the bit of the overrides alone. `BlockRotation` writes the turn the block is drawn with (46) from
the x axis of the multileader's plane, as the block's own plane sees it, as AutoCAD writes it: 30 degrees on a multileader
turned a quarter draws the block turned 120, where the library drew it turned 30.

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.BlockPosition`, and the block moved with a landing (a last vertex set, a dogleg's length), leave the
block's matrix (47) as it is, as AutoCAD 2021 leaves it (check D31e, k-moved-right, d4-k-blockscale2-moved, b-k-scale2-dl5);
the library moved its translation with the block. The matrix is written where the scale, the turn or `TransformBy` is set.

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.TransformBy` of a mirror draws the block where the mirror puts it with its normal mirrored, its x
scale negative and its turn read from its y axis, and gives a multileader of a block a plane of the mirrored normal, an x
axis on the side the old one keeps and its y across them (297 of nought), as AutoCAD 2021 writes them (check D31e): the box
turned 30 degrees and mirrored across the XY plane is of normal (0, 0, -1), scales (-1, 1, 1) and turn 330 degrees, its
plane's y axis (0, -1, 0); mirrored across the YZ plane, of normal (0, 0, 1) and the plane's x axis (1, 0, 0), met at
(-120, 55). The block is drawn as before; a `BlockScale` of 2 then set draws it at (130, 45) and (-100, 45), as AutoCAD
does, where the library drew it at (110, 45) and (-70, 45). Words mirrored are carried as before.

**FIXED.** Words that name a text style given to a `DxfMLeader` in no drawing keep it when the multileader is added to a
drawing that has it, with the bit of the overrides (11) where it is not the style's, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps the words of a
multileader made in memory (check D31e, f6-def-words-ts2): words of TS2 make it of TS2, where the library gave it its
style's text style. Words that name none take the style's, as before.

Existing tests changed (5): `DxfMLeaderTests` (3: a line of a leader added takes the vertex given as the landing, a block
placed leaves its matrix, and `BlockScale` and `BlockRotation` no longer among the setters that leave the file byte for
byte), `DxfMLeaderD31cTests` (`BlockScale` and `BlockRotation` set as they are write the matrix, as AutoCAD's own files of
D31c show) and `DxfMLeaderD31dTests` (the mirror about the y axis made the half turn it is in AutoCAD). 20 new tests of 32
cases, 29 red at base (`DxfMLeaderD31eTests`).

## 13.3.0 (2026-11-02)

A minor release: 48 public members are added, all in `GeometryHelper.Dxf`, and none is removed or renamed. Of its 78
entries, 11 NEW, 41 FIXED and 26 CHANGED, all but six are DXF, each checked against what AutoCAD 2021 reads, writes or
works out. Dynamic blocks set their horizontal, vertical and radial constraint parameters by solving the block's
constraints, their expressions taking AutoCAD's functions, and AutoCAD sets the library's INSERTs again; they take block
properties tables, polar parameters and polar stretches, and attribute definitions locked in their block in their
actions. Tables fill, turn kinds of value, set overrides, put rows and columns in and take them out, merge cells and read
their lines as AutoCAD 2021 does; multileaders land, explode and scale as it does, and splines are fitted through their
points as it fits them. Callers will see results change: a multileader's `TextHeight`, `LandingGap`, `ArrowSize`,
`DoglegLength` and `BlockScale` read unscaled where its scale is not 1 or `TransformBy` scaled it; `DxfTable.SetDataType`
and `SetOverrides` turn a value or give an override where they refused, `Fill` fills as AutoCAD fills, and new cells hold
no value where they held an empty text; a spline through fit points is a cubic of chord-length knots whatever degree is
asked, a SPLINE whose control points are not its fit is read as the fit, and `ToPolyline` gives closer to AutoCAD's vertex
counts; round in a constraint expression takes a half up, round(-2.5) being -2 where it was -3; `DxfDatabase.Insert`
copies an INSERT of a block the other drawing has not, where it refused the drawing. On the geometry side, `ToPolygon3`,
`ToFace3` and `ToPolyline3` lay a shape into a frame, and `ProjectToPolygon2`, `ProjectToFace2` and `ProjectToPolyline2`
lay it out, side for side however short a side, where the global tolerance took short sides out; a polygon or a face seen
edge-on is refused, where it came out as a line of corners. `TransformBy` of faces and solids reads the transformation
once, its results the same to the bit.

**NEW.** The expressions of a dynamic block's constraints take the functions of AutoCAD's help but random, the constants pi
and e and the remainder %, as AutoCAD 2021 worked them out through its own variables (check D34, 150 expressions): trunc,
floor, ceil, sign, exp, exp10, ln, log, sinh, cosh, tanh, asinh, acosh, atanh, d2r and r2d, and min, max and pow of two
values apart by a semicolon or a comma, where an expression of any of them was refused. Each is whole or real as AutoCAD
keeps it: trunc, floor, ceil, sign and % whole, min and max of the kind of the value they give, the first of two equal
(max(2;2.0) the whole 2), the others real. pi and e come before a variable of their name, as AutoCAD read pi*1 beside a
variable pi of 5; % is of the level of * and /, of whole values only and of the sign of the first (-7%3 is -1). What
AutoCAD would not work out is refused: random, which it draws anew each time, a value out of a function's range (ln(-1),
acos(2)), a division or a remainder by nought, a remainder of a value not whole (7.5%2), a whole number past 32 bits from
round, trunc, floor or ceil, and min or max of one value or three.

**CHANGED.** round in such an expression takes a half up, as AutoCAD 2021 does: round(-2.5) is -2 and round(-0.5) 0, where
the library gave -3 and -1, and round(0.49999999999999994) 1 (check D34). A division by nought is refused where it is made,
as AutoCAD refused 1/0, where max(2;1/0) gave 2; a sum, a difference or a product of whole values past 32 bits is real, as
AutoCAD kept 2147483647+1.

**CHANGED.** Setting a constraint parameter of a dynamic block is up to ten times faster, every value the same to the bit
on the 225 sets of AutoCAD's samples of checks D27 and D27b, under .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10: the solver keeps its
matrices by columns, works out the decomposition of the block's own equations once for the check of the base points and
the attempts that share it, and stops rotating a column of nought (its squares within 1E-200 of the largest's), whose
numbers too small for a double went round 80 times. DIA of the imperial Hex Head Bolt takes 81 milliseconds where it took
803 (.NET 10: 103 where 652), HdCr of the metric one 74 where 285, Wt of the metric WF Beam 84 where 334; the 225 sets but
the first of each file take 3.6 seconds where they took 10.5.

**NEW.** A polar stretch takes attribute definitions locked in their block, to stretch and to turn only
(`AddPolarStretchAction`), and an INSERT's ATTRIBs of them turn and move with them, as AutoCAD 2021 worked them out within
3E-13 on INSERTs plain, turned a quarter at the scale 2 and mirrored (check D34): a left one at (100, 10) in the frame goes,
at a Distance of 150 and an Angle of 30 degrees, to (124.904, 83.660), turned by 30 degrees. One not locked in another
writer's polar stretch stays where it is, its ATTRIB with it, as AutoCAD left it; such INSERTs were refused. An attribute
definition in a flip or an array stays refused: AutoCAD 2021 placed one a flip held by its font's extents, and did not set
an INSERT of an array holding one (eInvalidInput).

**NEW.** AutoCAD 2021 set again the library's INSERTs of its Parking sample, a block of a network and no constraint
parameter, set to a Width, a Length, a row or a number of Spaces, just as it set its own, 10 sets 0 apart in R2010 and
R2018 (check D34); the copy of the network D27b writes needed no change. A justified TEXT of no group 11 reads its alignment
point at (0, 0, 0), as AutoCAD 2021 read it. 13 new tests (`DxfDynamicBlockD34Tests`), 12 red before; 2 tests changed: the
expression refused in `DxfDynamicBlockD27Tests` and `DxfDynamicBlockD27bTests` is log10(1), which AutoCAD has no function
of, where it was exp(1).

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.Fill` fills as AutoCAD 2021 fills (check D33, 38 fills read by AutoCAD as its own): the options
`None` alone change nothing, where the library copied the cells; `CopyContent` copies the content alone and wins over
`GenerateSeries`; `CopyFormat` copies the look and kind of value, a cell of no value given one of none of that kind; a
series goes on from the source's last number wherever the fill range stands (1.5 and 2.5 filled above them to 3.5 and 4.5)
and with `Reverse` back from its first, the fill range's last cell next to it (10 and 20 to -20, -10, 0, where the library
wrote 10, 0, -10), its numbers shown of six places from R2007 on (0.300000); the source repeats from the fill range's first
cell; the source's columns are filled whatever columns the fill range names, where the library refused other columns; and
a fill range that holds a cell of the source is refused (`ArgumentException`), as AutoCAD refuses it.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.SetDataType` turns a value as AutoCAD 2021 turns it (check D33): a value not of the kind becomes one
of none of that kind (`93 7`), where the library refused it (the text B-12 made a number); a number made a whole number is
cut towards nought (12.7 to 12, -12.7 to -12); a text made a number is shown in the drawing's units under `%lu6` (12.0000)
or in powers of ten under `%lu1` (1.0000E+03), where the library wrote 12; the value's flags lose their 2 (`93 4`) but where
a text of a whole number is made that number. Kinds other than a text, a whole number and a number are still refused.

**CHANGED.** `DxfTable.SetOverrides` gives a cell the overrides named as AutoCAD 2021 gives them (check D33, 23 edits read
by AutoCAD as its own): one it does not hold is given AutoCAD's value (the text height 0.18, the alignment its row shows,
the colour by block, a background of none), where the library refused it; its alignment and background are kept whatever
is named; its kind of value (0x40000) is taken away unless named, where the library kept it. `DxfCell`'s looks set to null
still take only that look away.

**CHANGED.** `SetFormat` writes a number under an architectural format (`%lu4`) in feet and inches as AutoCAD 2021 does:
12.5 under `%lu4%pr2` is 1'-0 1/2", -0.25 -0'-0 1/4", 7.25 under `%lu4%pr2%zs1` 7 1/4"; the library left 12.5. `SetValue`
takes the cell's format away, as AutoCAD does, where the library kept it.

**CHANGED.** From R2007 on a cell's overrides set are written before its 92, in AutoCAD 2021's order, those it held after
its value moved there with them (check D33 s30 to s35); the library wrote them after the value. AutoCAD reads both alike.

Existing tests changed (16): the Fill tests of `DxfTableStructureTests` (6: reverse series, series above, six places, the
options copied with, a range meeting the source) and of `DxfTableDataLinkTests` (1), the refusals and flags of
`SetDataType` and `SetOverrides` in `DxfTableCellsTests` (3, two renamed), and the places of overrides written in
`DxfTableCellsTests` (2), `DxfTableStructureTests`, `DxfTableD28bTests`, `DxfAutoCadChecksD12Tests` and
`DxfAutoCadChecksD13Tests` (1 each). 36 new tests, 35 red at base (`DxfTableD33Tests`).

**CHANGED.** A `DxfMLeader`'s sizes are read and set unscaled, as AutoCAD 2021's API reads and sets them (check D31c, 111
multileaders AutoCAD made; 30 the library made read by AutoCAD, 29 as it made its own): `TextHeight` and `LandingGap` read
the size drawn over the `Scale` and are written times it, words drawn 8 high and a gap drawn 4 at a scale of 2 reading 4
and 2, where the library read 8 and 4, and a gap of 3 set there written 6 (145), where the library wrote 3; `ArrowSize` reads
the arrows drawn over the scale (140), so that a multileader of arrows 4 scaled by 2 by `TransformBy` reads 8, where the
library read its own 4 (42), which a line of no size of its own still reads (`GetArrowSize`); `DoglegLength` reads the
first leader's dogleg over the scale, 16 after `TransformBy` by 2 and 15 after `SetDoglegLength(0, 15)`, where the library
read the multileader's own 8 (41), which it still reads where there is no leader; `BlockScale` reads the multileader's own
scale of the block (10) and writes the block drawn times the scale (16), a block drawn 2 at a scale of 2 reading 1, where
the library read 2, and a block given after the scale is drawn scaled. Any caller of these getters on a multileader of a
scale other than 1, or scaled by `TransformBy`, gets the unscaled number now; at a scale of 1 and untransformed, the numbers
are the same as before. `TextAttachmentType` sets the left side alone, as AutoCAD's does, where the library set the right
too: three lines met on both sides, set to the bottom of the bottom line, stand at (100, 65.33, 0) and keep the right at the
middle of the top line.

**CHANGED.** A `DxfMLeader` property set to the value it has sets its bit of the overrides (90) all the same, and nothing
else, as AutoCAD 2021 sets it (check D31c): the leader lines' type, colour and lineweight, the landing, the gap, the dogleg
and its length, the arrow block, the attachments of the four sides, the turn and alignment of the words, their height and
frame, the scale, the leaders run on to the words (bit 30, now set by that property as AutoCAD sets it), and the block's
colour, scale, turn and connection; the library changed nothing. `SetDoglegLength` sets the bit of the doglegs (7) as
AutoCAD does, where the library set none. A leader line given the look it has (`SetLeaderLineType`, `SetLeaderLineColor`,
`SetLeaderLineWeight`, `SetArrowSize`) has it written and flagged as its own from R2010, as AutoCAD flags it. The colour of
the words, the content, the block, the direction of the attachment, the annotation scale, the places and the style still
change nothing.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader` with a block scaled by `Scale` has the block drawn scaled, as AutoCAD 2021 draws it (check D31c):
the library left the block's drawn scale (16) as it was. Met by one leader, the block moves so that the leader's longer
dogleg meets it at its end, the dogleg's start kept: the box of lines from (-10, -5) to (20, 15) at (100, 50, 0) met from
the left stands at (118, 45, 0) at a scale of 2 and (136, 40, 0) at 3, met from the right at (72, 45, 0); met on both
sides, it stays and the leaders are landed anew, from (64, 60, 0) and (156, 60, 0). Its matrix (47) is the block's
transform where it stood, as AutoCAD writes it.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader` made in code writes the text style of its words (340 of the context data) as AutoCAD 2021 writes
it, where the library wrote 0; a new multileader, and one given a style by `MLeaderStyle`, takes the style's text style (343
and the words' 340) where it names one and the multileader does not override it (bit 11), where the library wrote Standard.
A multileader given a style of no arrow block has its arrow block taken away, as AutoCAD takes it, where the library kept the
old style's, unless the multileader has one of its own (bit 8). One leader of several on a side given its own dogleg length
lands anew, its start moved by the change, the content staying, and so do several given `DoglegLength`, as AutoCAD 2021
lands them; the library moved nothing for the one and the content for the several.

Existing tests changed (6): `DxfMLeaderTests` (3: the right side kept by `TextAttachmentType`, the arrows read 8 and 12
after `TransformBy`), `DxfLeaderStyleAndPlaneTests` (2: the height and gap of Standard scaled 2 read 4 and 2; the look a line
has set again changes nothing before R2010 alone, renamed), `DxfD31Tests` (1: the dogleg and arrows read 16 and 8 after
`TransformBy`, the multileader's own 41 and 42 still 8 and 4). 20 new tests of 48 cases, 47 red at base
(`DxfMLeaderD31cTests`).

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.AddLeaderLine(point)` lands a new leader on a block as AutoCAD 2021 lands it (check D31b): on the
side of the block's box the point is on, with no gap, its dogleg ending where the block's shapes meet the line along x
through the middle of its box, or through its position where the block is met at its base, the outermost such point on that
side, else that point of the line. The box of lines from (-10, -5) to (20, 15) placed at (100, 50, 0) is met from (0, 0, 0)
by a dogleg from (82, 55, 0) and from (250, 0, 0) by one from (128, 55, 0); a circle of radius 10 with a line across it to
(20, 5) by doglegs from (82, 50, 0) and (118, 50, 0), the line reaching further right left out, as AutoCAD leaves it. The
library made the leader at the base point of the content, its dogleg along x whatever the side. `BlockConnectionType` set
is written in the context data too (177), where AutoCAD 2021 reads it. 3 new tests, of 18 cases.

**CHANGED.** A `DxfMLeader` keeps its landings as AutoCAD 2021 keeps them when a property is set after its leaders, where
that needs no font (check D31b, 59 of the library's multileaders read by AutoCAD as it made its own): `LandingGap` moves
the words along x by as much as the gap grew, with leaders or none, and the doglegs on their right by twice it, a gap of 5
for 2 moving "ABC" from (100, 50, 0) to (103, 50, 0); `DoglegLength` and `SetDoglegLength` move the words or block away from
leaders on one side only, words met on the right to (93, 50, 0) for a dogleg of 15 from 8, and land leaders on both sides
anew, from (83, 48, 0) and (127.67, 48, 0); `SetLastVertex` and `SetVertex` of a last vertex carry the content and the
other landings with the landing, words met from (90, 48, 0) set to (50, 60, 0) standing at (60, 62, 0), as a block does;
`TextHeight` and `Scale` move words met on their left only, to (100, 53, 0) for a height of 10 and (110, 52, 0) at a scale
of 2; an attachment of a side set moves the words or lands the leaders of the right anew by the change below the words'
top; and words given anew by `MText` keep their landing rather than take the place given. The library left the words and
block where they were. Words AutoCAD lands by their font's width (met on the right while their height or scale changes) and
`SetFromStyle()` are left as before. 7 new tests; 1 test changed: the words placed last where the height, dogleg,
attachment and gap set before it now move them.

**CHANGED.** Attachment 8 of a `DxfMLeader`, the underline of every line, underlines the words as AutoCAD 2021 writes it
(check D31b): where a leader meets them on a side of that attachment, "ABC" is written `\LABC`, whether the attachment, the
leader or the words come last; words that begin with `\L` or have no letters are left, and the attachment set away from 8
takes the `\L` off again. The library wrote the words as given, which AutoCAD draws without the underline. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** A `DxfMLeader` made in code and appended to a drawing, and one given a style by `MLeaderStyle`, takes the style's
linetype of the leader lines (341) and its arrow block (342), as AutoCAD 2021 writes them (check D31b), where the
multileader does not override them; the library wrote neither, and AutoCAD drew such a multileader's leader lines ByLayer
where its own are ByBlock. `ArrowSize` set is written anew even where it is the size the multileader has, its bit of the
overrides set, and the arrows drawn its size times the `Scale`, as AutoCAD writes it: 5 at a scale of 2 draws them 10,
where the library drew them 5, and 4 after `TransformBy` by 2 draws them 4 again. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** `DxfMLeader.Scale` scales the height of the words (44) with their width, as AutoCAD 2021 scales it (check D31b):
words 60 by 30 at a scale of 1 are 120 by 60 at 2, where the library left the height at 30; words in columns keep their width,
columns and gutter (43, 142 to 144), their height alone scaled, as AutoCAD keeps them, where the library scaled their
width. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** A spline is fitted through fit points as AutoCAD 2021 fits one that is not periodic (check D32, its own plugin
run headless): one cubic whatever degree is asked, its knots the lengths of the chords, at an end given a tangent the
derivative there that tangent at the length it is given, written as given, and at an end given none the curve bent no
more. Through (0, 0), (30, 40) and (60, 0) `FitData` gives the cubic of (0, 0), (10, 20), (30, 60), (50, 20) and (60, 0),
where the library gave a quadratic of averaged knots; through five points, alone or with tangents of length 1 or 5, its
control points are AutoCAD's to 1E-13, where the library's were up to 8.7 off, and so are those of `InsertFitPointAt`,
`RemoveFitPointAt` and `SetFitPointAt`. A closed spline given no tangents has the corner at its seam AutoCAD gives it
(70 1065), points a trillionth apart are one, and the fit points written are those fitted through, the closing one with
them. The reader's spline of fit points alone is the same cubic (two points the straight cubic of 4 control points, not a
line of degree 1), and a SPLINE of fit points whose control points are not their fit is read as the fit, as AutoCAD reads
it: the library's closed cubics of 70 11 of check 17-g give AutoCAD's 44 vertices at 10, not 54. A move, turn or scale keeps
the length of a tangent (5 scaled by 2 stays 5, as AutoCAD keeps it, where the library wrote 10 and AutoCAD fitted 26.7
off); a control point or the knots set, and `UpdateFitData`, take the fit data out, which AutoCAD would otherwise fit anew
over the change (its 1064 saved 8, its 3115 2059); `PurgeFitData` takes the flag 32 out with the 1024 (8, 2059); a knot put
into a spline of fit points keeps its 8 control points and gives its fit points at its knots (70 1288), where AutoCAD read
the 5 fit points left in as 7. Of the library's 87 edits of AutoCAD's cubics through five points, AutoCAD now reads every
file as the library does to 3.5E-14, but a fit tolerance of 0.5 (the fit within a tolerance is not done) and a weight set
(AutoCAD drops it on reading its own). 19 new tests; 7 tests changed: three points fit a cubic, `UpdateFitData` takes the fit
data out, a purged 3115 is 2059, two fit points read as a cubic, the entity whose reading throws is a splined LEADER of
vertices 1E200 apart (a SPLINE of such fit points is refused now, not thrown on), the viewer's warning of a spline of fit points alone, and the periodic cubics of checks 17f and 17n are built 70
3115 with no fit points, as AutoCAD saved them.

**FIXED.** `ToPolylineWithPrecision` (and `ToPolyline`) made lines halve the spline until its points halfway, a quarter and
three quarters along each piece lie within max(1 / M, L / 10 000) / (p + 1)^2 of its chord's, L the spline's length, as
AutoCAD 2021 counts: 147 of its 156 counts at hand, where the middle alone within 1 / (M (p + 1)^2) gave 50. A quintic
Bezier gives 86 vertices at 0, and the same ten times its size, where the library gave 120 and 1 113; a rational cubic of
the weights 1, 2, 0.5, 3, 1 gives 130, where it gave 371; an S whose middle lies on its chord 173, where it gave one
segment. A closed spline of fit points not periodic (70 1065) has its knots in place as a periodic one: 52 of AutoCAD's 72
polylines of closed and periodic cubics, where 27 were.

**FIXED.** A MULTILEADER is exploded as AutoCAD 2021 explodes the ones it makes (check D31: 137 multileaders AutoCAD made,
exploded by its API and by `Explode()`, the same to 1E-6 but for the lines AutoCAD draws under, over or round the words as
long as its font makes them). A multileader whose leader lines are splined has no dogleg drawn, as AutoCAD's `EnableDogleg`
reads false for it though its 291 says 1, and its splines run to the end the dogleg would have: two lines splined from
(0, 0) and (0, 100) to a dogleg of 8 from (90, 48) give two SPLINEs fitted from the backs of their arrows to (98, 48) and no
LINE, where the library drew the dogleg and splines to (90, 48); `GetGeometry` reads them so too. A dogleg of no length is a
LINE of no length, where it gave none. The words and the block are in the multileader's own linetype and lineweight, the
SOLID of an arrow in its own linetype (it had the leader lines'), and an INSERT of an arrow block in its own linetype and
its line's lineweight, turned by an angle from nought to a whole turn (3.63, not -2.65). The words are as wide as the
record's 43 says, which the scale has scaled already: words 60 wide at a scale of 2 are written and exploded 120 wide, where
the library gave 240. 5 new tests; 2 tests changed: a splined multileader exploded gives no dogleg, and the multileader of
check 61 is given the landing of the file it came from.

**FIXED.** The last vertex of a leader line is read and written as AutoCAD 2021's `GetLastVertex` and `SetLastVertex` do
where the dogleg is not drawn (`EnableDogleg` false, or the leader lines splined): the end the dogleg would have, which the
line runs on to. A dogleg of 8 from (90, 48) taken away leaves the line ending at (98, 48), where the library gave (90, 48);
`SetLastVertex(0, (50, 60))` then puts the dogleg's start at (42, 60), as AutoCAD did, and `AddLastVertex(0, (70, 30))` gives
the vertices (0, 0), (98, 48) and (70, 30). A vertex moved elsewhere leaves the dogleg's start as it was, to the bit. 2 new
tests.

**FIXED.** The length of the doglegs and the scale of a MULTILEADER are written and read as AutoCAD 2021 writes and reads
them: the multileader's own length (`DoglegLength`, 41) and size of the arrows (42) unscaled, each leader's dogleg (40)
times the scale. `Scale` set to 2 leaves 41 at 8, where the library made it 16, draws the dogleg 16 and scales the width of
the words with the rest; `DoglegLength` 3 at a scale of 2 writes 41 of 3 and doglegs of 6, `SetDoglegLength(0, 1)` a dogleg
of 2, where the library wrote 3 and 1 drawn; `GetDoglegLength` gives the length over the scale, 8 for a dogleg drawn 16, and
nought for a leader that meets the words at their top or bottom. `TransformBy` scaling by 2 leaves the scale of the context
data and the multileader (40 and 45), its own 41 and 42 and the arrow sizes leader lines have of their own as they are, as
AutoCAD's does, and scales the rest: a multileader of scale 1 is still of scale 1, its doglegs drawn 16 and its arrows 8,
`ArrowSize` 4, where the library made it of scale 2 and wrote 41 of 16 and 42 of 8. `SetFromStyle` writes 41 unscaled too.
4 new tests; 4 tests changed: Standard scaled 2 gives `DoglegLength` 8 drawn 16, a multileader moved and scaled 2 keeps its
scale 1 and `ArrowSize`, and `Scale` doubled draws the dogleg twice as long and reads it as before.

**CHANGED.** `DxfMLeader.AddLeaderLine(point)` lands a new leader as AutoCAD 2021 lands it where that needs no font: from a
point on the left of words held at their top left and met on their sides, its dogleg runs along the plane's x axis to the
landing gap short of the words' left edge, as far below their top as the attachment of the left side says, the lines of the
words counted by their breaks. Words "ABC" 4 high at (100, 50), with a gap of 2 and a dogleg of 8 met at the middle of their
top line, are met by a leader from (0, 0) whose dogleg runs from (90, 48) to (98, 48), where the library started it at the
words' place, (100, 50), running into them; three lines met at their middle from (90, 41.33); with a gap of 5 and a dogleg
of 15, from (80, 48). Every attachment of the side, from the top of the top line to the underline of the whole, lands where
AutoCAD landed it (check D31, d04). A point on the left with only a leader on the right gets a leader of its own, as in
AutoCAD, where it joined the one on the right. On the right of the words, which AutoCAD lands as far right as its font
makes them wide, for a block, and for words turned, held otherwise or met at their top or bottom, the leader is made as
before. `TextLocation` set moves the doglegs and the base point of the content with the words, as AutoCAD moves them: the
words moved from (100, 50) to (120, 80) move the dogleg to (110, 78). Of 30 multileaders made so by the library, AutoCAD
read every one as the library reads it. 3 new tests, of 11 cases.

**CHANGED.** `DxfDatabase.Insert`, of either form, copies an INSERT of the other drawing that names a block that drawing
has not wherever it stands, as AutoCAD 2021's `Insert` copies one, placing nothing (check D31, rounds C, E, F): in its model
space and in a block it merges, where the library refused the whole drawing ("The drawing has no block Z for the INSERT to
place"), as in a block a copy brings, which it copied. The other's M holding a line and an INSERT of Z, which it has not,
inserted, gives this drawing M with its INSERT of Z; where this drawing has a Z the copy places it, as a DXF names its block
by name. The Debug line of `GeometryHelperLog` that said those in the blocks brought says these too, with how many place a
block of the name. An INSERT so copied that names the block `Insert(name, ...)` makes is walked for a round and refused, as
it would place that block inside itself. `WblockCloneObjects` still refuses one given among the entities, as AutoCAD's
refuses a set holding or reaching one (`eWasErased`); AutoCAD's DXFIN refuses a file holding one at all. 5 new tests.

**CHANGED.** `DxfDatabase.Insert`, of either form, no longer walks the blocks it merges and brings for one that would come to
insert itself where none can: where no INSERT, dimension or table of this drawing names a block it has not, and none of
the other drawing's names the block `Insert(name, ...)` makes, those blocks reach this drawing's and stop there. What it
writes is the same to the byte, and it refuses what it refused: the differential probes of D8, D7b and D10 (13 drawings
saved again, 91 copied and inserted, 60 000 merges of which 110 325 inserts went through, 6 000, 3 000 and 2 x 20 000
drawings fuzzed) give the same lines with the walk always made and with it left out. A drawing of 3 000 blocks nested one
inside the next is inserted in 401 milliseconds where it took 406 with the walk (.NET 10) and 321 where 331 (.NET Framework
4.8), made a block in 388 where 414 and 295 where 293, and 10 000 nested inserted in 910 where 921 and 956 where 976, the
least of 11 runs taken in turn.

**NEW.** A horizontal, a vertical or a radial constraint parameter of a dynamic block AutoCAD's Block Editor wrote is set,
where the library read its distance only: `DxfDynamicBlockReferenceProperty.Value` solves the block's geometric and
dimensional constraints, read from the associative network of its BLOCK_RECORD (`ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK`), by Newton's method
from the block's own geometry, the variables of expressions of it worked out, and writes the lines, arcs, circles and
polyline edges they hold into the INSERT's anonymous block before any action works on them (check D27). Width 1 200 of
AutoCAD's Fluorescent sample, a rectangle 1 000 by 500 fixed at its corner, moves its right side to x = 1 200; of its
Fluorescent, Window, Channel, Concrete Pipe, Hex Head Bolt and WF Beam samples, metric and imperial, the 51 values set
came out within 4E-11 of AutoCAD 2021's, which solved them once `AssocManager.EvaluateTopLevelNetwork` ran, and AutoCAD read
every INSERT so set as the library drew it, with no audit error of its own. A value that cannot be met without moving
geometry the constraints leave free is refused with `NotSupportedException`, nothing written, as AutoCAD moved such
geometry by rules of its own (the left side of its Door Elevation kept at a new Width, its Hex Head Bolt's fillets kept
whole at a new HdCr; 27 sets of its samples refused so), and so is a constraint or an expression of a kind no sample holds,
and a row of a table that would change a constraint parameter, as AutoCAD left the constraints as they were at a row. A flip
carrying a constraint parameter, as the Window sample's carries DoorWidth, is worked out, and mirrors its points; a table
whose properties must match a row keeps a constraint parameter at the value set, and one of no column leaves the table's
user parameters, as AutoCAD 2021 set them. Setting one takes 5 to 100 ms. The network is read, not written: AutoCAD 2021
solved an INSERT the library set again only after `RESETBLOCK`, and did not solve a minimal network written by hand. 10 new
tests.

**FIXED.** An INSERT whose constraint parameter the library set is set again by AutoCAD 2021 (check D27b): its anonymous
block is given a copy of the block's associative network at the values set, as AutoCAD writes its own, where it held none,
or the copy AutoCAD had written naming entities gone (eKeyNotFound). Each object of the network is copied with a handle of
its own, each handle naming the copy of what it named; the copy is listed by the drawing's network, its dependency on each
constraint parameter put last in the parameter's chain and among its reactors; the variables hold the values set (an
expression of the value to twelve significant digits, whole or real as AutoCAD keeps it), the geometry of the constraint
groups that of the anonymous block once the actions worked, and each dimension of a constraint is moved to the geometry and
shows its value as the drawing writes lengths, without which AutoCAD solved the copy wrongly. AutoCAD then set 15 values of
the library's INSERTs of 7 samples within 1E-12 of its own sets one after the other, its audit finding nothing the samples
had not. A value set is solved at twelve significant digits, as AutoCAD solved Height 612.3456789012345 at 612.345678901.
Constraint groups of R2018 (AC1032), as AutoCAD 2021 saves them, are read, where every constraint parameter of such a
drawing was refused. A constraint parameter a table whose properties must match holds reads as read only, as AutoCAD read
Fluorescent's Width and Height, and is set all the same.

**NEW.** Geometry the constraints leave free moves as AutoCAD 2021 moved it, where such a set was refused (check D27b): each
constraint parameter set keeps its base point along its distance, Width 1 000 of the Door Elevation keeping the door's left
side, and what is still free is held, the radii and the ends of arcs before the rest where all at once cannot be met, the
Hex Head Bolt's fillets kept whole at a new HdCr. Construction lines and angles of three points (the imperial Hex Head
Bolt's) are solved, and expressions take sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, sqrt, abs and round, angles in degrees, as
AutoCAD read `width*cos(60)` as half the width. Of the 79 values the library set on AutoCAD's samples, 77 came out within
3E-12 of AutoCAD's, where 27 were refused; the one refused is a row of a table that would change a constraint parameter.
10 new tests; 2 tests changed: a rectangle free to slide keeps its left side at a new Width, and `sin(30)` is evaluated.

**FIXED.** A row a table puts in or takes out leaves the kinds of its rows as AutoCAD 2021 keeps them: by the style of
each row in the TABLECONTENT, which the library now reads (check D28e, rounds E1, E2). The first row put into a table of
one row is the header, the rest data: `SetSize(3, 2)` or `InsertRows(1, 9.0, 2)` of a table of its title alone gives it a
header shown again (`93 0`, no `281`), whether the header was left out by the rows taken or by `IsHeaderSuppressed`, where
the library kept it out; a row after a lone row of data is a header out of its place, read as data with the header's
`170 5`. `DeleteRows` of the title leaves it out (`93 1`, `280 1`) and of the header the header (`93 2`, `281 1`), where
the library wrote neither and read the header as the title; a title moved down by `InsertRows(0)` is the title again once
that row is taken out. The table's own looks of a kind of which no row is left go from its head with their flags, the
header's background and height with the header (`93 4784258`), the data's with the last row of data. A block of merged
cells whose top left cell goes leaves the cell left its own content, as AutoCAD 2021 left it, where the library moved the
top left cell's there: the title of two columns that loses its first keeps an empty text, not Parts. 5 new tests; 2 tests
of the old moves now read the cell left's own content.

**FIXED.** `MergeCells` empties the other cells of the block, as AutoCAD 2021 empties them: text cells of no value (`91 0`,
`93 7`, `90 0`), their block taken out, their text style, height and colour of their own taken away unless they are the
table's own looks of their row's kind, their alignment and background kept, and in the TABLECONTENT of no content
(`95 0`); the library kept them unseen, so that a cell unmerged showed Qty again. The edges of the block take the lines of
its corners, its top and left the top left cell's, its right the top right cell's, its bottom the bottom left cell's, as
AutoCAD drew them: a green line over Qty goes where the line over Mark is red. 2 new tests; 2 tests that read a merged
cell's text after merging now read it empty.

**FIXED.** `ResetValue` and `SetCellType(TextCell)` leave a value of none (`93 7`, `90 0`, the cell's flag 0x40000 taken
out), as AutoCAD 2021 wrote them and read them as of no kind, where the library wrote an empty text. A number set by
`SetValue` from R2007 on is written with the text AutoCAD 2021 writes and shows, 12.500000 for 12.5 and 12.500 under the
format `%lu2%pr3`, and `SetFormat` of a decimal writes the text anew, where the library wrote 12.5, which AutoCAD showed as
it was; before R2007 the text is all a cell holds and stays the number whole, 12.5. 2 new tests; 3 tests that read 12.5,
12.50 or 12 now read the text of six, three or two places, and 2 tests of filled series read the value.

**FIXED.** `SetBackgroundColorNone` and `IsBackgroundColorNone` write and read a cell's 283 as AutoCAD 2021 does, in a
drawing of R2018 and of R2000 alike: 0 filled, with a colour of its own (`63 0`, BYBLOCK, where the cell has none), 1
unfilled, or no override at all where the row's kind is unfilled; the library wrote and read them the other way about.
1 new test; 1 test of the old 283 now reads 0.

**FIXED.** `SetGridColor`, `SetGridLineWeight` and `SetGridVisibility` of the rows of a kind write the table's own lines in
its head after its flags, where AutoCAD 2021 writes them and reads them onto each cell of the kind; it read those the
library put after the last cell as none. A table that holds its own after its last cell already is written there, as
before. 1 new test; 1 test now finds them in the head.

**CHANGED.** `HorizontalCellMargin` and `VerticalCellMargin` of a table of no margin of its own read its style once and keep
it until the drawing is changed: 2 000 readings of both take 0.8 ms on .NET 10 where they took 97 to 136, and 0.3 ms
on .NET Framework 4.8 where they took 86 to 88, the margins read the same. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** A TEXT, an attribute definition or an attribute not aligned left on its baseline always writes its alignment
point (11, 21, 31), the origin too, as AutoCAD 2021 wrote `11 0 21 0 31 0` for its own TEXT centred on its middle (check
D30): an attribute definition centred on (0, 0) gave the attribute `SetAttributeFromBlock` filled for an INSERT at (6000,
1000) no 11, and AutoCAD put it at the world's origin; it is now held by (6000, 1000), as AutoCAD's own was. `Justify`,
`HorizontalMode` and `VerticalMode` give a text of no alignment point the origin as one, `AlignmentPoint` set to the origin
writes it, and a justified text of no 11 from another writer is moved, turned and placed from the origin, as AutoCAD reads
it. An attribute of several lines made of such a definition stands its MTEXT at the origin, not at its first point.

**FIXED.** The copies of an array come cell by cell, row by row, each cell's entities in the order the array was given
them, as AutoCAD 2021 drew them (check D30): the seat and the back of a chair arrayed every 600 came as seat 0, seat 600,
seat 1200 ... back 0, back 600 ..., and now as seat 0, back 0, seat 600, back 600. The entities are the same; their order
and so their indices in the INSERT's block are AutoCAD's. Of D29's eight sample drawings, remade with attributes in
actions, AutoCAD 2021's 304 sets and the library's are 0 lines apart, entity by entity, where the three holding arrays were
2 008 lines apart, and AutoCAD's audit finds no error in them (check D30).

**NEW.** A stretch, a move, a scale and a rotate take attribute definitions locked in their block
(`LockPositionInBlock`), and the ATTRIB of each INSERT follows its definition as AutoCAD 2021 moved, scaled and turned the
library's (check D30): Width set from 200 to 150 on an INSERT turned a quarter turn at the scale 2 takes an ATTRIB a scale
holds from (480, 200), 10 high, to (485, 150), 7.5 high. An attribute definition not locked in its block is refused with
`ArgumentException`, as AutoCAD's Block Editor refuses it: AutoCAD left an unlocked one of the library's move, scale and
rotate where it was. A flip parameter beside other parameters stays refused: AutoCAD read Hand back as 0 again on the
library's door of a flip beside a Width, with or without its stretch, though the library now keeps an INSERT's history.

**CHANGED.** An INSERT of another writer's block whose move, scale or rotate holds an attribute definition not locked in its
block leaves the definition and its ATTRIB where they are, and a stretch moves the definition but not the ATTRIB, as AutoCAD
2021 did (check D30); the library moved both in a move. Such a block's scales, rotates and stretches of locked attribute
definitions, which the library did not set, are set. The look-alike of a Block Editor drawing in the tests of D24g locks its
two attribute definitions, as AutoCAD's Block Editor would have. 17 new tests.

**NEW.** A block properties table takes a column of the visibility state, `DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Visibility(block)`,
written as AutoCAD 2021's own `AddItem` wrote one (connection VisibilityState, text cells): each row names a state, which
the row shows and is matched by; and an empty cell (null) in an attribute definition's column, which gives the attribute an
empty text. AutoCAD 2021 read the library's table of Width, the visibility, a rotation's angle and MARK with no audit fault
and set and matched it as the library does, MARK of the empty cell reading an empty text (check D26b, 0 lines apart). An
angle's column is written flagged (293 of 1), as AutoCAD wrote the one it added. An empty cell of a parameter's column, which
AutoCAD's audit refused, is refused with `ArgumentException`; `new DxfBlockPropertiesTableRow(100.0, null)` is no longer
refused itself. A table whose properties must match a row is now set, as AutoCAD 2021 set it (check D26b, rounds a1 to a3):
a distance or an angle of a column takes the first row holding it beside the first row's other values, else, where its
column holds no value twice, the row holding it, else stands beside the first row's values; the library refused it.

**FIXED.** A block is dynamic where its extension dictionary holds its evaluation graph, not where it keeps the extended
data AcDbDynamicBlockGUID: the INSERTs of Bore, PVI, Station and Valve of AutoCAD's samples, of a GUID over an empty
dictionary, read as dynamic and AutoCAD 2021 read them as not (check D26b); a block of a graph and no GUID read as not. A
copy keeps such data as before. A list value set allows the block's own value where the list was written without it,
after the last value below it, and a value set is taken to it: Door Size of the Door sample, own 750, allowed 600, 700, 800
... and took 760 to 800, where AutoCAD 2021 allows 750 and took 760 to 750; an angle list too. A read-only lookup allows its
label of no match last (Custom of Roller Bearing), and a lookup of a visibility state reads the row of the state shown
(Part Number SSI-4 of Shoulder Screw, read Invalid Size). A table's row is read within 1E-7, as AutoCAD 2021 read it, not
within 1E-3. On AutoCAD's thirteen sample drawings the library now reads the INSERTs as AutoCAD 2021 does but for the
attributes of two annotative blocks (178 lines apart before, 12 now). An INSERT of AutoCAD's Parking sample is set: a copy
of a dimension that names no block, as its constraints' do, names none and is hidden, as AutoCAD keeps them, where every
set was refused ("no block named by the dimension"); AutoCAD read the library's Parking with the six hidden. An empty
attribute cell of a table read from a file gives the attribute an empty text when its row is set. 30 new tests.

**CHANGED.** Five tests that made a block dynamic by its GUID alone give it an evaluation graph too; the test of a row of a
null value now checks `AddBlockPropertiesTable` refuses it.

**NEW.** Block properties tables of dynamic blocks, AutoCAD's Block Properties Table. `AddBlockPropertiesTable` gives a
block a table of columns, each a property of one of its parameters (`DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Distance`, `X`, `Y`,
`Angle`, as a lookup's inputs) or an attribute definition (`DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Attribute`), and of rows
(`DxfBlockPropertiesTableRow`); `BlockPropertiesTable` reads a block's table back (`DxfBlockPropertiesTable`: its name, its
columns' names, its rows). Every INSERT shows the property Block Table1, a `short`, the index of the first row whose
parameters' values it shows, -1 for none; set to a row, it sets the parameters and the INSERT's attributes of the row: a
plate of Width, Height and MARK set to the row (200, 80, P200) is 200 by 80 and reads MARK P200. AutoCAD 2021 read the
library's tables with no audit error and read and set them as the library does, on INSERTs scaled by 2 too, 0 lines apart
(check D26). AutoCAD's own tables are read and, where their columns are of the parameters the library works out, set:
their user parameters of a text or a real are read and set, Spaces of AutoCAD's Parking sample taking Custom once Width is
set off its rows as AutoCAD 2021 gave it; their horizontal, vertical, aligned and radial constraint parameters give their
distances, read only. On the INSERTs of AutoCAD's thirteen sample drawings the library now reads every table's row, user
parameter and constraint distance as AutoCAD 2021 does (152 lines apart before, none now). 15 new tests.

**CHANGED.** A value set on an INSERT keeps the history of grip edits the INSERT keeps (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKHISTORY), the
value set added after it (the node's id, the property's name and the value read back), as AutoCAD 2021 kept its Parking
sample's history and added each value it set; the library took the history out. An INSERT of no history is given none,
as AutoCAD gave none to the library's INSERTs it set (check D26). The test that the history is taken out now checks it is
kept.

**FIXED.** Columns put in before the first column of a table's title merged across it, or after its last, merge the title
anew, as AutoCAD 2021 merged it: `InsertColumns`, `InsertColumnsAndInherit` and `SetSize` leave each cell of the title
but its first empty and of no value (`91 0`, `93 7`, `90 0`), under the title's top line, and give each cell of the row
under it the title's bottom line, where the library kept the title's other cells as they were, (0, 1) still of an empty
text, and the lines under it; a green line under Qty where the line under Mark is yellow is made yellow, as AutoCAD drew
it. A column put in among the title's columns grows it as it is, as before. A new cell that takes the look of another
takes every line of it, rows and columns alike, and the blocks of merged cells along it, a row merged across or a
column merged down, as AutoCAD 2021 merged the new ones; the new title cell of `InsertColumnsAndInherit` is of no value.
AutoCAD read the library's files of these edits as it read its own files of them back, the D28c case of the column of
Qty among them. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** A row `SetSize` puts in is 4/3 of the text height the table style gives the data and twice the margin above
and below a cell's content, 9 for AutoCAD's Standard of 4.5 and 1.5, as AutoCAD 2021 made it under rows of 15 or 20,
6.333333333333333 for a style of 2.5 and 12 for the table's own margin of 3, where the library made it as high as the
last row. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** A row put in before a table's title or header is of data, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps it. The record tells a row's
kind by its place alone, so `InsertRows(0)` now leaves the title and the header out (`93 3`, `280 1`, `281 1`) and
`InsertRows(1)` the header (`93 2`, `281 1`), and the title or header moved down takes as its own the looks of its kind
the data's are not, `170 5` and `140 6.0` for the title of AutoCAD's Standard and `170 5` for the header, with the
table's own of its kind, as AutoCAD wrote them; the library read the new row as the title or the header, and the old
title as the header or data in the data's look. A row put in at or before the first row of data takes the table's own
looks of the data out of its head, the old rows of data given them as their own, as AutoCAD did. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** A row `InsertRowsAndInherit` puts in from the title or the header is of that kind, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps it:
merged across as the title is, its cells given as their own the looks of the kind the data's are not and the table's own
of the kind, and the header left out where a title goes in before it (`93 2`, `281 1`); one put in the kind's own place
is the title or the header, the old one moved down taking the looks. The library gave the new row the overrides of its
cells alone, unmerged, read as data in the data's look. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** `HorizontalCellMargin` and `VerticalCellMargin` of a table of no margin of its own read its table style's (the
TABLESTYLE's 40 and 41), else that of AutoCAD's own Standard, 1.5 in a drawing of millimetres and 0.06 in one of inches,
as AutoCAD 2021 read them, where the library read 0.06; `AttachmentPoint` places a cell's content in by them, 1.5 in
AutoCAD's Standard. Reading a margin a table does not give of its own reads its style each time, some 25 microseconds on
.NET 10 where it read 0.06 at once. 1 new test; 7 tests that read or placed by 0.06 in a drawing of millimetres now read 1.5.

**CHANGED.** `RemoveAllOverrides` writes the one cell's groups in the place of their bytes, the rest of the record copied as
it is: taking every cell's overrides away one by one, 806 cells of 403 rows, takes 1.7 to 2.4 s on .NET 10 where it took 5.5 to 6.0, and 2.8 on .NET Framework 4.8 where it took 6.3 to 14; the drawing written is the same
to the byte, checked after each of the first eight cells and after all of them in 46 drawings.

**FIXED.** A line between two table cells is read as AutoCAD 2021 reads it: as the top or left edge of the cell below or
right of it where that cell holds the edge (its edge flag in 172 and one of the edge's overrides at least), else as the
bottom or right edge of the other, each property of the line from the edge that holds it. `GetGridColor`,
`GetGridLineWeight`, `GetGridVisibility`, `GetGridProperty` and `GridColor(row, col, edge)` read the bottom of (1, 1)
of AutoCAD's own table, which AutoCAD writes as the top of (2, 1), as none, and read an override of no edge flag as a
line; AutoCAD read the bottom of (1, 1) red and the top of (2, 1) green as green either side, and the top of (2, 1) of a
colour alone with the bottom of (1, 1) of a lineweight alone as no lineweight. The bottom or right of a cell set is set
on the cell that holds the line too, and a top or left set takes first the properties of the line the cell above or
left of it gives, so that a line set reads as set and keeps what was not set. Reading every line of a table of 403 rows
takes 2.2 ms where it took 1.9; `SetGridProperty` of every line of 4 003 rows 125 ms on .NET 10 where it took 90 to
112, 160 to 177 on .NET Framework 4.8 where it took 134 to 141. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** `RemoveAllOverrides` and `ClearTableStyleOverrides` take a cell's overrides out wherever they stand outside its
value, as AutoCAD 2021's `RemoveAllOverrides` took `170 5`, `7 GH_TXT` and `140 3.5` out from before the 92 of its cell
(1, 0), where the library cleared their flags and left the groups, and take the edges of its lines out of its edge flags
(172 9 to 0). 1 new test.

**FIXED.** `InsertRowsAndInherit` and `InsertColumnsAndInherit` give the new cells the overrides of the cell whose look
they take wherever they stand, AutoCAD's text style and height before its 92 among them, which the library left out, and
the edges of its lines (172), as AutoCAD 2021 wrote them; an empty value of the kind 512 for a value of no kind. In the
TABLECONTENT each new cell of `InsertRowsAndInherit` takes that cell's format, its margins and lines, and an empty value
of the flags 5 with the format of its content where it holds one, as AutoCAD wrote them, where the library wrote cells
of no content and no format; `InsertColumnsAndInherit` alike. AutoCAD read the library's files of `InsertRowsAndInherit`
as its own edits; the lines of `InsertColumnsAndInherit` it copied but for the top of a cell under its merged title,
which the library copies, a difference left for later.
On AutoCAD's own table, whose TABLECONTENT cells are of full formats, 200 rows put in so take 0.9 to 1.6 s on .NET 10
where they took 0.56 to 0.6, the TABLECONTENT written being as large as AutoCAD's. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** Each new cell of a column `InsertColumns` or `SetSize` puts in takes as its own the looks the table gives of its
own to its kind of row (alignment, text style, background, colour, text height), as AutoCAD 2021 gave the new header cell
of a table of its own header of 9 `140 9.0` with its flag 0x20: AutoCAD reads a cell without them by its table style
alone, 4.5. A new row's cells take none, as AutoCAD's took none. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** The table's own overrides AutoCAD 2021 writes in the table's head, after its flags (93 to 96) and before its
heights, are read: `HorizontalCellMargin` and `VerticalCellMargin` (`93 8`, `40 3.0`), `IsTitleSuppressed` and
`IsHeaderSuppressed` (`93 2`, `281 1`), `GridColor(gridlineType, rowType)` and its kin, and the text heights of the
kinds of rows, which a table scaled now scales and gives its cells, and `SetSize` reads for the width of a new column;
`ClearTableStyleOverrides` takes them out, and `SetGridColor(color, borders, rows)` writes in their place there. A
column `SetSize` puts in a table of one row, its title merged across it, is 1 wide, as AutoCAD made it, where it was the
title's 9; a title merged across some of the columns and a column merged down to the last row grow only by what goes in
among them, as before and as AutoCAD left them. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** A distance set on a dynamic INSERT halfway between two values of a list goes to the block's own value where it
is one of the two, else to the one written first, the lesser of a list written from the least up, whatever the value
before, as AutoCAD 2021 took all 358 such ties of lists of 3 to 6 values of a linear, an XY and a polar parameter, from
every value of the list and alike in two sessions. Of 50, 100 ... 300 for a block's own 100, 75 goes to 100 where the
library gave 50 coming from 100 or 300; for an own 250, 125 goes to 100 where an XY or a polar parameter gave 150. The
library took a linear list's tie to the value farther from the one before (131 of the 278 linear ties) and an XY or a
polar list's to the value nearer the block's own (32 of 80). A tie of steps goes to the step below as before, 95 to 90 for
an own 100, as AutoCAD took all 100 such ties. 48 new tests; one test of D24c changed to AutoCAD's values (75 to 100, 100
to 80), one of D24d renamed.

**NEW.** A polar parameter takes a stretch and a move by its end point, `AddStretchAction` and `AddMoveAction` overloads of
`DxfBlockPolarParameter`, of a distance multiplier and an angle offset too: they follow the end point unturned, a circle at
the tip of a shaft from (0, 0) to (100, 0) going to (0, 150) for a Length of 150 at a quarter turn, as AutoCAD 2021 drew
them. A lookup table takes columns of an XY parameter's distances (`DxfBlockLookupInput.X` and `Y` of a
`DxfBlockXYParameter`), a polar parameter's distance and angle (`Distance`, `Angle`) and a rotation parameter's angle
(`Angle`), angles in radians: a plate's Size Large gives 200 by 80, a needle's Way North a quarter turn, and its Angle set
to pi reads West, as AutoCAD 2021 read and set them, 0 lines apart. Blocks of other writers holding them are set where they
were refused. A lookup set reads the label of the first row of its values, as every other does, as AutoCAD 2021 read Small
after setting Twin, a row of the values of Small further down; it kept the row set. New public API only; nothing removed.
11 new tests.

**FIXED.** `DxfTable.IsLinked` reads a cell of a linked range as AutoCAD 2021 does: linked where AutoCAD lays it out
from the ACAD_TABLE, its TABLECONTENT cell holding no content or one whose checksum disagrees with the cell's text, and
not where it holds a content of an agreeing checksum. The library's own link over (1, 0) to (2, 1), its cells of no
content, AutoCAD read linked at all four, where the library read (1, 0) alone; AutoCAD's own, its other cells holding an
empty value of the checksum of their text, at (1, 0) alone, as before. **CHANGED.** A table the drawing's
ACDB_RECOMPOSE_DATA does not list has no link of its TABLECONTENT, as AutoCAD read none of its own linked table with
that record listing its style alone or nothing; `SetDataLink` lists such a table. 4 new tests; 4 tests of D18, D19 and
D21 whose fixtures held no content read those cells linked now, and the D16 fixture of AutoCAD's linked table lists the
table in ACDB_RECOMPOSE_DATA, as AutoCAD's did.

**FIXED.** A table's merged cells are read by the spans (175, 176) of each block's top left cell alone, as AutoCAD reads
them: AutoCAD writes that cell `173 0`, so `GetMergeRange` and `IsMergedCell` read AutoCAD's own title of Parts as no
merge, and `MergeCells` and the row and column edits did not see it. `GetMergeRange` of every cell of a table of 403
rows takes 1.7 ms on .NET Framework 4.8, where it took 24. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** An override set on a table cell that has one is written in its place, before the cell's 92 where AutoCAD
2021 writes its own: `SetTextStyle` of AutoCAD's cell (1, 0) of `7 GH_TXT` wrote a second 7 after its value, which
AutoCAD read and the library did not, and `SetTextHeight` alike. **FIXED.** `SetGridColor`, `SetGridLineWeight`,
`SetGridVisibility` and `SetGridProperty` name the edge in the cell's edge flags (172: 1 top, 2 right, 4 bottom, 8 left),
without which AutoCAD reads no line of a cell, wherever it stands: the bottom of (1, 1) set red read as none, and reads
red now. 2 new tests.

**CHANGED.** The rows, columns and cells a table's edits make take AutoCAD 2021's forms: a new cell of `InsertRows`,
`InsertColumns` and `SetSize` holds no value (`93 7`, `90 0`), which AutoCAD reads as none, where it held an empty text;
one of `InsertRowsAndInherit` the empty value `93 5` of the kind of the cell it inherits. The title merged across the
table grows over the columns `InsertColumns` puts in first or last, and those of `SetSize`, Parts kept in (0, 0); a merge
of another row moves on, as before. A column of `SetSize` is as wide as the text height of the first row whose new cell
is merged with none and the margins either side, 7.5 for AutoCAD's Standard, where it was as wide as the last. The
TABLECONTENT's heights and widths are written as reals, 10.0, and a formula's field of a row or column taken out goes
out of its list after the rows and is erased. AutoCAD read the library's file of each as its own. 4 new tests; 4 tests
of D28 and 4 of `DxfTableStructureTests` changed to these forms.

**NEW.** A dynamic block takes a polar parameter and its polar stretch, as AutoCAD saved ACadSharp's sample of them:
`AddPolarParameter` gives every INSERT a distance and an angle, and `AddPolarStretchAction` turns the entities it holds
about the base point as the angle turns, moving the points inside its frame along the line as the distance grows, and
turns the entities given to turn only. A pointer from (0, 0) to (100, 0) set to 150 and a quarter turn runs to (0, 150),
its polyline (50, -5)-(100, -5) held by its end going to (5, 50)-(5, 150), as AutoCAD 2021 drew it; AutoCAD read and set
every INSERT of such a block, and the library sets one as AutoCAD does, the anonymous block the same to 1E-9 in every set
that was not a tie. `AddRotationParameter` and `AddXYParameter` take value sets in new overloads, and `AddPolarParameter`
one for the distance and one for the angle, taken as AutoCAD 2021 took them: an angle round the circle, 300 degrees to 0
of 0 to 90 and 338 to 0 of 0, 90, 180 and 270, and a tie of a list of distances as the first entry above says.
`DxfBlockParameterValueSet.List` takes nought, for an
angle. A rotation, an XY or a polar parameter of a value set from another writer is set too, where it was refused. 50 new
tests.

**FIXED.** `DxfTable.InsertRows`, `InsertRowsAndInherit`, `DeleteRows`, `InsertColumns`, `InsertColumnsAndInherit`,
`DeleteColumns` and `SetSize` put the rows and columns in and take them out of the table's TABLECONTENT too, as AutoCAD
2021's own do, where they left it as it was. AutoCAD reads a table's links, the style of each row and the borders of its
cells from the TABLECONTENT cell by cell: a row put in above AutoCAD's link at (1, 0) took the link to the new row, and
a row of data moved up into the header's place read as a header, centred. Each new row is one of data of empty cells, a
link moves and grows with its cells and goes with them, its DATALINK then no longer tied to the TABLECONTENT, the table
kept among its targets, as AutoCAD wrote it; `MergeCells` and `UnmergeCells` list the merges there too. AutoCAD read
the library's edits of rows and columns as it reads its own. 8 new tests.

**NEW.** `DxfTable.SetDataLink` links a table of no TABLECONTENT, as a program other than AutoCAD writes one, from R2007
on, where it refused it: the table is given a TABLECONTENT as AutoCAD 2021 gave the ezdxf table of its 73 one, with the
XRECORD of ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLE_ENTITY, the table and its style listed in ACDB_RECOMPOSE_DATA, without which AutoCAD
reads no TABLECONTENT, and the class TABLECONTENT. AutoCAD read the link of (1, 0) so made in R2018 and R2007; a range
of several cells it reads linked at every cell, where the library reads its top left alone. A drawing before R2007 is
still refused. 2 new tests; one test of D17 changed from the refusal to the link.

**FIXED.** A text or value given to a table cell whose value has the flag 1 (93 of 1, 5 or 7, as AutoCAD writes a block
cell's, a formula's and an empty one's) is written with the flags 6 AutoCAD writes for a value it is given: AutoCAD
2021 read such a value as none, whatever its text, so a block cell made a text cell and given M16, or AutoCAD's formula
cell given Plain or 5, showed nothing. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** `ToPolygon3` and `ToFace3` of a `GeoPolygon2` or a `GeoFace2`, and of `PlanarMap`, lay the polygon, its
holes too, into the frame side for side, however short a side, as `TransformBy` carries one in space: the triangle
(0, 0), (10, 0), (10, 10) with every corner cut by 0.3, shrunk in the plane by a thousandth, keeps its six corners 0.0003
apart, where the global tolerance of a thousandth put it back together as three. Of 500 random polygons with cut
corners, shrunk in the plane by a tenth to a ten-thousandth, 68, 410, 500 and 445 lost corners laid into a frame, and
none do now; faces with a hole likewise. A polygon still has to enclose an area within the global tolerance: shrunk by
a ten-thousandth, 38 of them, under a thousandth across, are refused, where 55 were. 3 new tests.

**CHANGED.** `TransformBy` of a `GeoFace3` or a `GeoSolid3` reads the transformation once and hands it to every polygon,
where every polygon read it again: the box 100 by 70 by 40 sheared takes 3.0 microseconds on .NET Framework 4.8, where
it took 5.0, and 1.1 on .NET 10, where it took 1.7, as before an uneven transformation was checked at a loosened
tolerance. The results are the same to the bit. 2 new tests.

**FIXED.** `ToPolyline3` of a `GeoPolyline2`, and of `PlanarMap`, lays the chain into the frame leg for leg, however
short a leg: (0, 0), (10, 0), (10, 0.0004), (20, 0.0004) keeps its four vertices, where the global tolerance of a
thousandth took the step out. Of 2 000 random chains with legs down to 0.0002, 1 211 lost a vertex laid into a frame,
and none do now.

**FIXED.** `ProjectToPolygon2`, `ProjectToFace2` and `ProjectToPolyline2` of a polygon, a face or a chain in space, and
of `PlanarMap`, lay it out side for side, however short a side; only a side seen end-on, along the Z axis of the frame,
goes. The square 10 by 10 with a corner cut by 0.0005, laid out in a frame tilted 60 degrees to it, keeps its five
corners, where the cut corner was put back. Of 2 000 random polygons with cut corners down to 0.0001, laid out in frames
tilted 0.3, 1.2 and 1.5 radians, 36, 569 and 860 lost corners, and none do now; of 2 000 chains, 1 198 lost a leg that
had a length, and none do. **CHANGED.** A polygon or a face seen edge-on is refused, as one that encloses no area is
when it is built, where it came out as a line of corners: of the 2 000 polygons laid out exactly edge-on all were
returned and all are refused now, and a ten-thousandth of a radian off edge-on all are kept as slivers. The results
that kept every corner before are the same to the bit. The booleans of flat faces lay faces out as they did. 8 new tests.

**CHANGED.** `TransformBy` of polygons one by one with the same `GeoTransform3` reads the transformation once: the
transformation keeps its reading, read again for a shear or a stretch only when the global tolerance changes. A polygon
of eight corners sheared takes 0.59 microseconds on .NET Framework 4.8, where it took 0.71, and 0.25 on .NET 10, where
it took 0.35; moved or scaled evenly, a little less. The results are the same to the bit.

**FIXED.** A caret in the words of an MTEXT, a TEXT, an ATTRIB or ATTDEF and a MULTILEADER's MTEXT is read as AutoCAD
2021 reads it, in `Contents`, `Text`, `TextString` and `ContentsRTF`: `^J` a line feed, `^I` a tab, `^M` a carriage
return, `^` and a space a caret, and a caret and any other character the one 64 below it, `^a` an exclamation mark and
`^?` U+FFFF; `^@` ends the words there, so `x^Iy^@z` is x, a tab and y. `Contents` and `TextString` kept `x^Jy` as
written, and `Text` read only `^@` to `^_` and dropped the character nought, going on to z. 4 new tests.

**CHANGED.** `DxfMText.Contents` and `DxfDBText.TextString` write a caret set as `^` and a space and a tab as `^I`, as
AutoCAD writes them, so that `m^2` and `\S1^2;` read back as set: they were written as given, which AutoCAD and the
library now read as m and U+FFF2. `SetContentsRtf` gives the length of the words as `Contents` gives them. 1 new test.

**FIXED.** `DxfMText.ContentsRTF` keeps %% and what follows it as written, `x%%%y`, `x%%248y`, `x%%cy` and `x%%d`
among them, as AutoCAD 2021's `ContentsRTF` keeps them; it made them a per cent sign, ø, ∅ and the degree sign. A line
feed read from `^J` is `\line`, as AutoCAD writes it, where it was `\par`. 8 new tests.

**FIXED.** A multibyte code `\M+` whose first byte is a letter alone and whose second is 00 is that letter, as AutoCAD
2021 reads it: `\M+1A400` is U+FF64 and `\M+58000` the euro sign, where they were kept as written. One with a byte that
is no letter of its page, a letter of private use alone counted as none, is kept as written in `Text` too: `\M+100FF`
was U+F8F3 in every text, and `\M+180FF` U+0080 in `Text`. AutoCAD gives such a code a letter of its own from U+E800 on,
numbered in the order it meets them in a session, which no reader of one file can give. 4 new tests.

## 13.2.0 (2026-11-01)

A minor release: 126 public members are added, all in `GeometryHelper.Dxf`, and none is removed or changed. Of its
176 entries, 15 NEW, 111 FIXED and 50 CHANGED, about half are DXF and half geometry. Dynamic blocks are made in code and
set as AutoCAD sets them: linear, XY, point, rotation, flip, visibility, lookup, alignment and base point parameters,
with stretch, move, scale, rotate, flip and array actions, each written as AutoCAD 2021 saved ACadSharp's sample of it,
and `DxfDynamicBlockReferenceProperty.Value` reads and sets their properties on an INSERT. `new DxfDatabase(version)`
makes an empty drawing, `DxfTable.SetDataLink` links cells, and `DxfTextSymbols` holds the symbols of AutoCAD's text
editor. Texts read their escapes and `%%` codes as AutoCAD 2021 reads them, and a few more drawings no longer make files
AutoCAD will not open. On the geometry side, `TransformBy` of a polygon, a face or a solid under an even scaling carries
the shape as a move does: of 9 600 random bodies scaled, stretched or mirrored, 1 460 were refused or came back open,
and none now. Fillets, chamfers, offsets, cuts and shortest lines read each short side and small arc as it is, in the
plane and in space, and booleans and the measures of bodies with openings, asked at or below the rounding of the
coordinates, no longer trust a wrong or open result. Welds that close a crack between two bodies weigh a corner a face
